name: ngautopilot-skills
description: A skills-only package of NgAutoPilot engineering guidance.

interface.longDescription: NgAutoPilot provides reusable, version-aware skills for Angular upgrades, architecture, testing, TypeScript, JavaScript, frontend quality, and release validation. This package contains skills only and has no MCP server or external service connection.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use NgAutoPilot to identify the smallest relevant engineering skill and propose a bounded validation plan.
